correctness.rationale: The proof constructs an explicit bijection between all labelled extensions and independent radius-ball choices, derives the EGF recursively, and includes equality patterns by labelled substitution. Each U_j grows asymptotically negligibly beside U_(j+1), so the converse identity is forced. Explicit 4-point nonisometric witness and exhaustive <=3-point partition shapes establish sharpness. The new checker tests 99 cases independently but is not used as an infinite proof.
